title: nte-character-geometry-budget
summary: Compare an NTE character mod with the matching official cooked mesh to set realistic triangle, vertex, section and LOD budgets. Use before substantially densifying custom garments or embroidery, or when a character mod causes poor performance or excessive package size. Does not authorize reducing accepted detail, changing original character assets, or substituting archive compression for runtime optimization.
